12. A company’s new computer system is being developed.
(a) The system analyst decided to use direct observation as a method of gathering data
about processes that are carried out.
(i) Identify two advantages for the system analyst of using direct observation to
gather this data. [2]
(ii) State one method of gathering data from end-users other than direct observation. [1]
(iii) Identify two advantages for the system analyst of using the method stated in
part (a)(ii). [2]
A prototyping approach is being used to develop the new computer system.
(b) (i) Outline one advantage of prototyping. [2]
(ii) Outline one disadvantage of prototyping. [2]
The company’s management is considering whether all its data will be stored locally or
remotely using a cloud service.
(c) Compare and contrast local storage and cloud storage in terms of data security,
cost, and accessibility. [6]
